research.primalmagickextended.familiar_c: I have learned to summon or reshape creatures, and built a portal to another realm. I've formed bonds with animals, but I believe I can make a deeper bond, a magickal bond. It would take a ritual to craft it into a physical form.

I have figured out the ritual. A few runes of power, and a few items attractive to beasts, to lure their spirits close and link them to mine. The ritual will produce a collar, which I can give to any animal that's already tamed and loyal to me. Bound to my spirit, it would be protected - anything that harmed it would instead have it slip away into another realm, where I should be able to summon it back to me.
In addition, such a beast present nearby could bear some of the cost of spellcasting for me, contributing its mana to mine and making spellcasting easier.
I can keep only one familiar; binding another would release the first back to ordinary life, though still loyal and unharmed. To call or dismiss a familiar at will, however, I will need a spell.
research.primalmagickextended.find_famil: With a familiar bound, its presence lingers at the edge of my thoughts even when it is far away. Surely that thread can be pulled upon with a spell.

Find Familiar is a spell that calls my bound familiar to my side if it is absent, or dismisses it if it is present. The spell's target is unimportant, as it travels along the familiar bond and not through space.
A familiar that was dismissed, lost, or seemingly destroyed returns whole, still bearing its name and collar.
tooltip.primalmagickextended.familiar_co: Binds a tamed companion to you as a familiar
